classes.name: ResetDatabaseController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for resetting the database to its initial savepoint during functional tests. It implements a handle method that performs the restore and returns the number of tables restored in a JSON response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to reset the database, restoring to initial savepoint and returning the count of tables in the response.
